metadata.title: Hermite-Fisher bounds and stability for min-entropy power inequalities
metadata.abstract: We derive explicit lower bounds for relative Fisher information by combining a variational principle with suitably orthogonalized Hermite-polynomial test functions. The resulting cumulant bounds are asymptotically sharp and yield lower bounds for Gaussian entropy deficits. We also establish quantitative versions of sharp min-entropy power inequalities in all dimensions. En route, we develop a stability result for Brzezinski's sharp bound for block sections of products of Euclidean balls, which may be of independent interest.

analysis.workSummary: 作者以正交化 Hermite 多项式测试函数推导相对 Fisher 信息显式下界，得到渐近锋利的累积量界和 Gaussian 熵亏损下界，并建立 min-entropy power 不等式的定量版本。
analysis.breakthrough: 同时给出欧氏球乘积块截面锋利界的稳定性结果。
analysis.limitations: 具体分布假设、距离和稳定模量未在摘要展开。 本条依据官方摘要与评论整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立核查记录为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 联系凸几何与信息论，对不等式方向有专题价值。
